messages:
Tariq: PSA: I found a half-full bubble tea in the fridge with a sticky note that says 'Do not judge'. who does it belong to? :tea:
Elena: guilty. it was mine. I left it as a science experiment on straw longevity. :eyes:
Miko: science experiment? that's a thesis topic. name: 'Metastable Tapioca Under Office Conditions'
Tariq: nice. also tiny one-liner challenge: best office science pun wins the rest of the tapioca (if it's still edible).
Elena: "Our team's retention strategy is basically tapioca."
Miko: "My commit history looks like a fermentation log."
Tariq: "My calendar is in a committed relationship with chaos."
Elena: vote with emoji for your fav pun. :point_up:
supply-bot: Station update: fresh paper towels added to kitchen. :notebook: (automated)
Miko: :thumbsup: for 'fermentation log'
Tariq: :star: for 'committed relationship'
Elena: tie! tie-breaker is who brings snacks tomorrow.
Miko: fine, I will bring the brave bin of mixed cookies.
Tariq: quick kudos to @Elena for saving the meeting when the projector died. hero of the hour. :zap:
Elena: thank you, team. moral: never underestimate a person who owns a HDMI dongle.
Miko: closing note: bubble tea lives on the top shelf of the fridge for now. approach with caution. :warning:
